criteria.evidence: HttpSourceLoader sends If-None-Match only for syntactically strong ETags (quoted opaque-tag, no W/ prefix, valid etagc) and only to the request location matching the cached responseSource. A 304 must contain exactly one identical strong ETag field value before digest-checked cache bytes are reused. Missing, weak, different or ambiguous confirmation and missing cache bytes cause exactly one unconditional retry; a second unusable 304 is a load error. Strong confirmed hits remain effective: independent probe observed 4 requests / 0 body responses on the cached rerun, while an unconfirmed 304 (ETag other) and a strong-to-weak transition forced unconditional 200 loads.

Independent local-HTTP probes reproduced the old weak-validator cases: constant W/"dep-logical-1" with a changed representation and Last-Modified within the same second both produced exit 1 and ILI-RES-0009 with reason CHANGED_SOURCE and no lock. With a cached old lock, the same weak ETag produced LOCK_MISMATCH online and an explicit source pin produced PIN_MISMATCH. Exact offline lock replay returned the old A bytes with 0 HTTP requests. Model requests carried neither If-None-Match for the weak ETag nor If-Modified-Since for Last-Modified.

Offline with a cached index, missing optional ilisite.xml and an absent model gave a visible ILI-RES-0008 SITE_UNAVAILABLE/OFFLINE warning plus ILI-RES-0001 NOT_FOUND, exit 1 and 0 HTTP requests. After deleting the required index body, the same offline request gave ILI-RES-0003 LOAD_FAILURE/OFFLINE naming .../ilimodels.xml. A malformed optional site returned ILI-RES-0008 INVALID_INDEX and NOT_FOUND, not INDEX_FAILURE. The added DefaultRepositoryCacheTest asserts CLI INPUT_UNRESOLVED and null HTTP; required index/model failures remain real errors.

RepositorySearch still records all optional site failures in unavailable() for lock and final-verification provenance; only the error classification uses the package-private unavailableIndexes(). Required index/model failures remain distinct real failures. The diff does not weaken no-store, Vary, cancellation, size, warning-limit or gate handling, and does not change repository selection or public signatures. The audited 68 focused contract tests in 10 suites have 0 failures/errors/skips.

Independent hash audit matched all 288 manifest production/build files, all 10 test sources and all 7 distribution JARs; javap confirms the new repository logic in the shipped JAR. RED XML has 7 tests / 7 failures with the expected old-bug messages; GREEN XMLs total 68 tests / 0 failures / 0 errors / 0 skips; the final regression log runs only the regression suite and its XML has 7 green tests. Own CLI/HTTP counterprobes exercise the optional-site, weak-ETag, Last-Modified and strong-ETag paths. Spec chapters 08/13/14/15/16/17/18, README and implementation status are consistent with the stricter no-weak-proof rule; no required proof was invented.

counterprobes.name: weak-etag-changed-source
counterprobes.evidence: Constant ETag W/"dep-logical-1"; model A then B. write-lock child exit 1, ILI-RES-0009 reason=CHANGED_SOURCE, no lock. 4 requests/3 bodies; both model responses were 200 with ifNoneMatch=null. A would have matched the weak tag if sent, so the old 304 path is not used.

counterprobes.name: weak-etag-lock-pin-offline
counterprobes.evidence: First write-lock exit 0 (4/3). After server switched to B: read-lock online exit 1, ILI-RES-0009 reason=LOCK_MISMATCH (2/1); source-pin for A online exit 1, reason=PIN_MISMATCH (2/1). Offline read-lock exit 0 with model SHA A and 0 additional HTTP requests.

counterprobes.name: last-modified-changed-source
counterprobes.evidence: Constant Last-Modified within one second; model A then B. write-lock child exit 1, ILI-RES-0009 reason=CHANGED_SOURCE, no lock. 4 requests/3 bodies; model responses were 200 A and 200 B with ifModifiedSince=null both times.

counterprobes.name: strong-etag-hit-confirmation-transition
counterprobes.evidence: First run 4 requests/2 bodies, model 200 then confirmed 304. Cached rerun 4 requests/0 bodies, all 304, model SHA A. A 304 with ETag "other" was rejected and reloaded unconditionally (6 requests/2 bodies). A 304 with W/"model-v2" on transition to B was rejected and reloaded unconditionally; final model SHA B (5 requests/2 bodies).
